caption: The video captures a horizontal brass-colored cylindrical workpiece held in a metal lathe chuck at the left, with a dark upper jaw and a lighter lower jaw visible beside the piece. A teal band encircles the cylinder, with a small lifted flap at its right edge. A dark pointed metal tool extends from the right and keeps its tip against the surface near that edge. The tip wanders throughout, drifting rightward through the middle and later portions before returning leftward and lower across the band. Thin bright horizontal lines emerge on the teal band below the tool, growing from a single faint mark into two clearer streaks. The framing stays close and steady, the band's edges holding roughly fixed while the chuck jaws remain in view and the roaming tool tip and brightening lines dominate the visible motion.
